# mtncloud_user_group (Data Source)

Provides an MTN Cloud user group data source: looks up a user group by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_user_group" "tf_example_user_group" {
  name = "TF Example User Group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the user group
- `name` (String) The name of the user group
